# Data sets of the generalisation runs (not distributed; all public)

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `GSE68086_TEP_data_matrix.txt.gz` | GEO GSE68086, supplementary file (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE68086) |
| `singh.RData` | `datamicroarray` collection, `data/singh.RData` (https://github.com/ramhiser/datamicroarray) |
| `gordon.RData` | `datamicroarray` collection, `data/gordon.RData` (https://github.com/ramhiser/datamicroarray) |

Place the files here unchanged. `pmtrd/datasets.py` documents the fixed, label-free preprocessing;
`configs/generic_*.json` name the files and the positive class.
